bid.note: Equipment rates, crews and productions on this job are from the WPM HeavyBid cost report 26-1-085 (RRISD Stony Point HS Pk 2 100% CD, printed 11/16/2026): one crew per estimate activity, labor at the burdened rate. Crews are pre-assigned to the takeoff items they match; material prices, trucking and general conditions are not carried over.

basis: Documents: drawing set 25-0039.00 Pkg 2 (100% CD, 5/29/2026; civil sheets by Gil Engineering dated 2-13-2026), the CAD files, spec volumes 1 and 2, Addendum 1 (6/11/2026) and Addendum 2 (6/26/2026).

Both additions are structural slabs over a crawl space on drilled piers (S001). The earthwork under them is excavation from existing ground down to the UNDERSLAB contours and spots on CG101 and CG102, graded to the crawl-space inlets and sumps. North addition: finished floor 732.80, underslab 722.95 to 728.30, footprint taken as 10,555 SF, excavation 2,810 CY. South addition: finished floor 746.24, underslab 736.56 to 741.74, footprint taken as 16,451 SF, excavation 2,894 CY.

All grades come from Grading Plan.dwg in Texas Central state plane, exported so its Civil 3D surfaces come out as geometry: existing ground from the existing 1 ft contours (plus the 'match existing' notes), the crawl-space floors from the underslab contours and spots, and the exterior finish grade from the proposed contours and spot labels (each spot taken at the tip of its leader), tied back to existing at the edge of the work.

Work limits are not a polygon in the CAD: taken as 10 ft around each addition and 5 ft around the new sidewalk, asphalt and curb. Footprints are the hull of the underslab contours and spots plus 1.5 ft, not a wall line.

Sections from CP500: sidewalk 5 in concrete on 6 in flexible base; heavy duty HMAC 3 in on 8 in crushed limestone base with geogrid over 6 in lime treated subgrade (treated in place, not excavated). Areas are the new-sidewalk, asphalt and curb hatches in Design.dwg.

Strip 4 in assumed over the whole work area; much of it is existing sidewalk and asphalt that is demolished rather than stripped. No shrink or swell. The geotechnical report is not in the bid documents, so nothing here is checked against it.

Not in this takeoff: grade beam and pier excavation, backfill against the crawl-space walls (S001 asks for free-draining granular fill 2 ft wide), hydro excavation, erosion controls, topsoil respread, and the 6 in lime treatment quantity.
